Use targets pipeline templates

use_targets_template.Rd

Use targets pipeline templates

Usage

use_targets_template(dir = NULL, type = c("deseq2"))

Arguments

dir

default = NULL, which will use current working directory; path to directory to copy template files to

type

character, choose which targets pipeline template to use. Available options include "deseq2".

Value

copies template files, functions, Quarto report templates and any demo data needed to run the pipeline into the working directory.
